Read Me.null: Deterministic, explicitly synthetic records for developing and testing PMI data ingestion, IFC-to-task graph construction, schedule revision handling, and progress forecasting.
Bridge and building are separate generated scenarios. Treat project_id as a mandatory grouped holdout; never split rows randomly across the same project.

Scenario structure is informed by the shared research chat: component-level bridge progress, PORR infrastructure task/model linkage, and Texas Mid-Rise schedule scale/update modalities. No project records were copied.
All names, IDs, geometry, schedule dates, progress, resources, dependencies, revisions, and event records are generated. They are not observed construction history.

Seeded deterministic rules. Planned durations vary by work package and element quantity. Actual dates include modest task-level delays. Progress snapshots are monotonic and reach 100% at synthetic actual finish.
Suitable for pipeline, schema, graph, and controlled-model prototyping. Not valid as evidence of real-world accuracy or as a substitute for obtaining project-authorized data.
Elements.element_id joins to ElementTask.element_id; Activities.task_id joins to ElementTask.task_id, Dependencies predecessor/successor_task_id, Progress.task_id, and ScheduleVersions.task_id.

IFCModels includes the two generated IFC4 files; element GlobalIds and task IDs in each IFC model match Elements and ElementTask. Other tabs contain the synthetic schedules, links, dependencies, progress, and revisions.
Lengths and dimensions in metres; area in m²; volume in m³; progress in percent; durations in calendar days.
